card.name: The digit 8 in numbers
card.fires_on: The single digit 8 (sometimes 9) written inside a longer number. It is most often the third digit of a 1300s year such as 1380 or 1389, and also appears in phone numbers, ISBNs and report codes.

modes.label: Years in the 1380s
modes.description: The digit 8 as the third digit of a late 14th-century year in history text.

modes.description: An 8 or 9 inside a phone number, ISBN or report code.
